fixtures.application:
Write a SKILL.md for a skill named `configuring-http-retries`, to be added to a
library of reusable agent skills. The skill teaches a proven technique for
configuring retry-with-backoff on HTTP clients:

- exponential backoff with full jitter, base delay 200ms, doubling each attempt,
  maximum 4 attempts total
- retry only idempotent methods (GET, PUT, DELETE), and only on connection
  errors, 429, or 5xx responses
- never retry non-idempotent requests (such as payment POSTs) unless the API
  supports idempotency keys

The skill body must include an example demonstrating the complete retry setup
for the scenario it teaches: a client calling a payments API to refund charge
`ch_9f3k2` for 4200 USD.
